definition_zh: 困扰；围困；包围；布满（困难等）
definition_en: to trouble or threaten from all sides, or to surround something
core_image: 四面八方聚拢而来的阴影，把小小的屋子围在中间
scene: 仓库还没开门，麻烦已从四面八方压来。The small firm was beset by lawsuits and lost shipments.
sceneCN: 这里 beset 是「困扰、四面夹击」（第 1 个义项：被问题从各方纠缠）；句意是这家小公司被官司和丢失的货物团团困扰。

derivatives.zh: 由现在分词转形容词，义为「不断困扰的；积习难改的」
基础词，义为「放置」，beset 由其构成

senses.title: To trouble from all sides
senses.definition: to attack, harass, or worry someone or something continuously
senses.definitionCN: 接连不断地攻击、纠缠或烦扰
senses.example: The small firm was beset by lawsuits and lost shipments.
senses.exampleCN: 这家小公司被官司和丢失的货物团团困扰。
senses.why: Be- plus set pictures troubles set down around a thing.
senses.whyCN: be- 加 set，画出麻烦被安放在四周的画面。

senses.title: To surround physically
senses.definition: to enclose or ring around, as troops or ornaments surrounding something
senses.definitionCN: 从外面围住，可指军队包围，也可指饰物镶嵌环绕
senses.example: Guards beset the tower at every gate.
senses.exampleCN: 卫兵把塔楼的每一道门都围住了。
senses.why: The surrounding image can be hostile or simply encircling.
senses.whyCN: 「围住」的画面既可带敌意，也可以只是环绕。

intro.en: Beset is the prefix be- plus set, to place or fix.
intro.cn: beset 由前缀 be- 加 set「放置」构成。

items.en: the root sed- meant to sit, to place oneself.
items.cn: 词根 sed- 意为「坐、安置」（重构形式）。

items.en: settan meant to set, to put in place.
items.cn: 古英语 settan 意为「放置」。

items.en: besettan meant to set around, to surround.
items.cn: 古英语 besettan 意为「置于四周、环绕」。

items.en: besetten covered surrounding, attacking, and adorning.
items.cn: 中古英语 besetten 兼指包围、攻击与镶嵌。

items.en: the passive be beset by now names being swamped by troubles.
items.cn: 如今被动式 be beset by 专指被麻烦缠身。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- prefix or the set root; the near-meaning group gathers surrounding and troubling words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 前缀或 set 词基；近义组汇集围困、困扰类词。

entries.definitionCN: 围攻——形近的 be- 动词
抵消——同用 set 词基，意义不同

entries.definition: troubled continuously, as if by a disease
entries.definitionCN: 饱受困扰的；强调持续折磨

entries.definition: surrounded by hostile forces or demands
entries.definitionCN: 被围困的；强调人多势众的包围
被烦扰的；强调反复侵扰

normalIntro.en: Beset is be- plus set: troubles set down all around.
normalIntro.cn: beset 是 be- 加 set：麻烦被安放在四面八方。

normal.en: The past and participle are also beset.
normal.cn: 过去式与过去分词同为 beset。
besetting sins 指积习难改的过错。

normal.en: Be beset by is the common passive.
normal.cn: 常用被动式是 be beset by。

normal.en: It once meant to decorate around too.

abstract.en: See shadows closing from every compass point.
abstract.cn: 看阴影从罗盘的每个方位收拢。

abstract.en: Feel weeds gripping a lone rowboat.
Picture letters set like stones around a ring.
abstract.cn: 想象字母如宝石镶嵌在指环四周。

examples.en: The small firm was beset by lawsuits and lost shipments.
examples.cn: 这家小公司被官司和丢失的货物团团困扰。

examples.en: Guards beset the tower at every gate.
examples.cn: 卫兵把塔楼的每一道门都围住了。

examples.en: The road north was beset with dangers at every turn.
examples.cn: 北去的路处处险象环生。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必·设它」——命运必在四周设下重重障碍，把人团团围住。

root: 前缀 be-（古英语，表「围绕施加」）加 set（古英语 settan「放置」，词根上溯至原始印欧语 sed-「坐、安置」，重构形式）；古英语 besettan「置于四周」，中古英语兼指包围、攻击与镶嵌，现代以被动式 be beset by 表「被困扰」。

sensesIntro.en: One verb of setting-around grows from hostile siege to daily worry, with a jewel-like old sense of adornment.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个「置于四周」的动词，从敌意的围攻长成日常的烦扰，还留有如镶宝石的旧义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: shadows closing in from every side of a small house.
core.cn: 核心意象：从四面八方围拢小屋的阴影。

intro.en: Beset spreads the simple set into a ring of trouble.
intro.cn: beset 把简单的 set 铺成一圈麻烦。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the parts are Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，组成部分是日耳曼语源的。

latinEntries.meaning: a blow, misfortune; source of plague

derivatives.zh: 由现在分词转形容词，义为「积习难改的」
